_what: HINT 365: everything the service needs outside the code, declared once. DR/infrastructure-as-code/rebuild.sh reads this file and creates what is missing (it never deletes). The Worker itself (code, bindings, cron, static files) is declared in worker/wrangler.toml and deployed by .github/workflows/build.yml.

d1.name: personalhealthy
d1.holds: accounts, readings, lab results, logs, settings

d1.name: personalhealthy-backup
d1.holds: copy of the acceptances of the terms (legal proof)

d1.name: personalhealthy-vault
d1.holds: nightly encrypted backups of the other two databases, 30 days (no card needed)

r2.name: hint365-backups
r2.holds: later (Google Play launch): an extra copy of the backups; needs R2 enabled (payment method) — not used yet

secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: Cloudflare token: D1 Edit, Workers Scripts Edit, Workers R2 Storage Edit, Account Settings Read (this account only)
secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64: the app's signing key (base64): keep an offline copy, without it no update can be installed over the app
secrets.AI_API_KEY: the owner's AI key for the Scan
secrets.OWNER_CODE: the owner's secret phrase for a new phone
secrets.GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID: Google sign-in (OAuth client of the Google Cloud project)
secrets.CONTACT_EMAIL: contact address shown in the privacy policy
secrets.PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: Google Play: subscriptions and the version live on the store
secrets.BACKUP_PASSPHRASE: the phrase that encrypts the nightly database backups: keep it in a password manager, without it a backup cannot be read

outside.google_cloud: OAuth client for Sign in with Google (web + Android, SHA-1 of the signing key); service account for Google Play
outside.google_play_console: the app ch.personalhealthy.app, the subscription hint365_annual, the AAB of every release
outside.anthropic_console: the AI key and its monthly spend limit

recovery.rpo: 24 hours (nightly backup); minutes within the last 7 days with D1 Time Travel
recovery.rto: 1 hour for a full rebuild from zero (measured by the drill: about 10–20 minutes of pipeline)
